div.head: VI Atr 7
div.ab: K. ⁊ gif wiccan oððe wigeleras, scincræftcan oððe horcwenan, morðwyrhtan oððe mánsworan ahwar on earde wurðan agytene, fyse hy man georne ut of þysan earde ⁊ clæ[n]sige þas þeode, oþþe on earde forfare hy mid ealle, butan hy geswican ⁊ þe deoppor gebetan.

⁊ gif wiccan oððe wigeleras, scincræftcan oððe horcwenan, morðwyrhtan oððe mánsworan ahwar on earde wurðan agytene, fyse hy man georne ut of þysan earde ⁊ clæ[n]sige þas þeode, oþþe on earde forfare hy mid ealle, butan hy geswican ⁊ þe deoppor gebetan.

And gif wiccan oððe wigeleras, scincræftcan oððe horcwenan, morðwyrhtan oððe mansworan ahwar on earde wurðan agytene, fyse hy man georne ut of þysan earde and clænsige þas þeode, oþþe on earde forfare hy mid ealle, butan hy geswican and þe deoppor gebetan.

Und wenn Zauberer oder Wahrsager, Magier oder Huren, Mordstifter oder Meineidige irgendwo im Lande betroffen werden, dann jage man sie eifrig aus diesem Lande und säubere dies Volk oder vernichte sie gänzlich im Lande, es sei denn, sie lassen [vom Bösen] ab und büssen um so tiefer.

And if witches or soothsayers, sorcerers or whores, murderers or perjurers are found anywhere in the country, let them be eagerly driven out of this country and this people be cleansed, or let them be utterly destroyed in the country, unless they desist [from evil] and atone all the more deeply.

And if wizards or sorcerers, magicians or prostitutes, those who secretly compass death or perjurers be met with anywhere in the land, they shall be zealously driven from this land and the nation shall be purified; otherwise they shall be utterly destroyed in the land, unless they cease from their wickedness and make amends to the utmost of their ability.

And if wizards or magicians, conjurors or prostitutes, murderers or perjurers be found anywhere in this land, they are to be zealously expelled from the realm and the people cleansed, or they shall be entirely abolished from the earth, unless they cease and most sincerely repent.

note.seg: scincræftiga belegt Toller nur hierher. Doch ist der Sinn gesichert durch scincræft, -gedwola, -hiw, -(ge)lac, -læca, -læce, -læc, -lic, -seoc
Toller records scincræftiga only for this passage. But the sense is assured by scincræft, -gedwola, -hiw, -(ge)lac, -læca, -læce, -læc, -lic, -seoc
Hinzuzudenken ist, dass der Zauber (s. d. Gl 3—4) einen Todesfall verursacht hatte; nur dann bedroht ihn Todesstrafe
It is to be understood that the sorcery (see that word in Gl 3—4) had caused a death; only then is it threatened with the death penalty
Das Wort kommt bei Tertullian, diese Orthographie bei Ducange vor. Neben Götzendienst steht Zauber (s. d. Gl 1a) auch sonst
The word occurs in Tertullian, this spelling in Ducange. Sorcery (see that word in Gl 1a) stands alongside idolatry elsewhere too
Cf. E. and G. 11; II As. 6; 6, 1; I Edm. 6; Wulfstan, p. 309.
No other instance of the form scincræftiga(-ca) is quoted in BT., see p. 833 and cf. scincræft.
